title:
Type for saving models from [HuggingFace Hub](https://huggingface.co/models) to remote file systems, such as S3, GCP, and ADL.
As described in more detail in {@link admin-model-inference-service.c3doc.md}, it is not recommended to deploy models with {@link VllmPipe#fromModelId} in production.
This type makes it easier to save models to remote, and later to use tools like {@link VllmPipe#fromRemoteUrl}, which is more reliable.

{@link HuggingFaceHub#saveModel} and {@link HuggingFaceHub#saveModelFromBatches} trigger a {@link DynBatchJob}, where for each batch,
the files in the batch are downloaded to a temporary directory on the task node and uploaded to the destination using {@link FileSystem}.
name: HuggingFaceHub
